answer: Each new account must lock 12 POA for 21 days and earn a signal score of 50 from three independent referees before it can claim rewards. Referees are limited to 5 endorsements per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 200 referee-epochs and 12,000 POA frozen, while an honest user locks 12 once. Related accounts form a trellis in the endorsement graph; each vine that grows from a single funder is audited at 6%, and a failed audit slashes 60% of the lock plus the referee's own bond.
